Package index

Input & data construction

Functions to validate a multirates input and build the corresponding Stan data list.

init_multirates()
Create a PEPI object for the unified multirates model.
check_input_multirates()
Check if multirates input data has the correct form.
build_stan_data_multirates()
Build the Stan data list for the unified multirates model.

Fitting

Functions to fit the unified multirates model.

fit_multirates()
Fit the unified multirates model.

Synthetic data

Functions to simulate synthetic driver/clade CCF trajectories for testing and demonstration.

simulate_multirates_tree()
Simulate synthetic input tables for `init_multirates()`.

Getters

Functions to extract posterior draws and predicted quantities from a fit.

get_posterior_multirates()
Extract and tidy the full posterior (and built-in prior draws) from a multirates fit.
get_predicted_counts()
Get posterior-predictive counts (z_*_pred) with observed counts joined in.
get_predicted_fractions()
Get posterior-predictive fractions (frac_*_pred) with observed fractions joined in.
get_predicted_ccf()
Get posterior-predictive CCF (ccf_*_pred) with observed CCF joined in.
get_predicted_mutations()
Get posterior-predictive mutation counts (m_*_pred) with observed counts joined in.
get_viber_clusters()
Clusters mutation with VIBER, a package that implements a variational non parametric Bayesian model to fit multi-variate Binomial mixtures
get_init_values()
Provide a initialization parameters for a PEPI VAF fit

Plotting functions

Functions to plot data, predictions and posterior/prior distributions.

plot_counts_multirates()
Plot predicted vs observed counts for the unified multirates model.
plot_fractions()
Plot predicted vs observed fractions for the unified multirates model.
plot_ccf()
Plot predicted vs observed CCF for the unified multirates model.
plot_mutations()
Plot predicted vs observed mutation counts for the unified multirates model.
plot_inference()
Plot posterior and prior distributions of the unified multirates model's parameters.
plot_multivariate()
plotting functions Plot multivariate VAF distributions with cluster associated to tree nodes.
plot_marginal()
Plot marginal VAF distributions with cluster associated to tree nodes.

Convergence diagnostics

Thin bayesplot wrappers for fits obtained with fit_multirates(..., method = "sample").

plot_diagnostics()
One-call convergence dashboard.
plot_trace()
Trace plots of the sampled chains.
plot_rhat()
Rhat (potential scale reduction factor) overview.
plot_ess()
Effective sample size (ratio to total draws) overview.
plot_acf()
Autocorrelation of the sampled chains.
plot_divergences()
Divergent transitions.
plot_energy()
Hamiltonian Monte Carlo energy diagnostic.
plot_treedepth()
NUTS treedepth diagnostic.
plot_pairs()
Pairs plot with divergences marked.
